title: Approvals inbox status filter: refusal for a non-string `status` prints "[object Object]", and the approvals docs page omits `cancelled`
body:
domain:server#4 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CZMkHvuDeVYgTD73qF

Follow-up to PR #30491 (card #29880), from contract review record https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/pull/30491#issuecomment-6659996154 (should-fix 1 and 2). Serial after #30491 merges.

## Observed

1. `GET /api/v1/approvals/requests?status[$ne]=pending` — the query parser hands `readApprovalStatusFilter` (`packages/rest/src/approvals-routes.ts`) an object. The route correctly answers `400 VALIDATION_ERROR` and does not call the service, but the non-string arm builds the bad-value list with `[String(raw)]`, so the message reads `"[object Object]" is not an approval status`. Read from the PR diff, not measured on a running server.
2. `content/docs/automation/approvals.mdx` (around L740) lists five request statuses; the object and the route accept six (`cancelled` is missing). Pre-existing; every listed value is accepted, the list is just short.

## Expected

1. A non-string `status` is refused with a message that says the parameter must be a single string or a comma list of statuses, naming the allowed values; status code, envelope and "service not asked" unchanged. Pin it in `rest-server-approvals-status-value.test.ts` (the nested-object case already exists; assert the message).
2. The docs list matches `APPROVAL_STATUSES` (six values).

## Out of scope

The console status picker (`ApprovalsInboxPage.tsx`) also lacks `cancelled`; that is ui lane (paused) and not part of this card.
